Captain Joshua Huddy — Prisoner of War

summary: According to HMDB, the Sons of the Revolution in New Jersey put up this monument to Captain Joshua Huddy as a prisoner of war in the town park in Highlands, in front of the bandstand. The plan's seed list names Huddy Park in Highlands; that this park is it has not yet been checked.
